result.summary: The page renders coherently with no blocking or critical defects; horizontal carousels with partially clipped items and vertically cut-off content at the bottom were excluded per the rules. Only two minor cosmetic/content inconsistencies were found.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card (Green Bowl Poké) uses an image with a light/white background and visible padding around the bowl, while the adjacent cards (Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria Piccolo) use photos that fill the entire image area with a dark background. This makes the first card look unfinished or inconsistently cropped.
issues.suggestion: Use a photo for Green Bowl Poké that fills the card's image area edge-to-edge (same aspect ratio and framing as the other cards), or standardize all card thumbnails to the same object-fit/contain treatment.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery information is shown twice: a '€0 delivery' pill overlaid on the image and '€0 delivery' repeated in the meta line ('25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen').
issues.suggestion: Keep the promotional '€0 delivery' badge and remove the duplicated value from the meta line (e.g. show '25–35 min · Ramen'), or drop the badge and rely on the meta line.
